blocks.text: JobQuestPH brings Las Piñas’ first hybrid job fair to 2/F Vista Mall Las Piñas, near the Cinemas, on October 27–28, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, followed by a Virtual Job Fair on October 29–31 at www.jobquest.ph. At the center of this experience is JobQuestPH’s new job fair portal, helping applicants connect with employers onsite and online. Jobseekers are encouraged to register early, complete their profiles, upload their résumés, and explore AI Job Match for job recommendations aligned with their profiles.
